questions.question: Which test data formats are supported by Robot Framework?

options.explanation: Robot Framework does not natively support JSON as a test data format
YAML is not a supported test data format in Robot Framework

questions.question: In Robot Framework test data, what symbol is used to separate cells in space-separated format?

options.explanation: Single spaces are not enough to separate cells; at least two spaces are required
Tab characters are used in TSV format, not in space-separated format
Pipe characters can be used but are optional and mainly for readability
